title: Armarium Transcript record
description: A completed record (including permitted stubs) as JSON-compatible parsed frontmatter and Markdown body.

body.description: At least one level-two content heading followed by a bullet item of attributed speech. Does not check every utterance or attribution accuracy; matching code-fence lines can satisfy it.

wikilink.description: Canonical wikilink without alias or anchor; target existence and kind require vault-aware checks.
